notes:
Lead profile: SMB vendor building a lightweight customer support automation layer on top of popular CRMs. They signed up for free credits and ran a couple of generation tests. Primary ask: automated ticket summarization + structured action extraction for triage and to populate their internal CRM.

What they want (high-level):
- One-click POC on Hosted API (self-serve) to prove latency and accuracy.
- Tool-calling pattern to surface: create_ticket, add_internal_note, suggest_kb_article (they use Zendesk & HubSpot).
- Structured output: strict JSON schema (summary, severity_score, suggested_tags[], sla_risk, kb_link). Must be deterministic enough to map to fields.
- Summarization quality: short human-ready summary (~1-3 sentences) + list of suggested next actions.
- Throughput target: pilot ~20-50 req/s, peak bursts up to ~100 req/s; cost-sensitive (wants cost per ticket < $0.02 ideally).
- Latency target: 95th <600ms for single-ticket summarization; faster for streaming preferred.

Security/compliance notes:
- Public cloud fine, but legal requires DPA and a clear data residency statement.
- Must support SSO for console + audit logs for model calls.
- Retention controls: ability to TTL logs/tokens after 90 days.

POC plan proposed on call:
1) Provide sample JSON schema + function-calling examples for their engineering team (due 2026-03-11).
2) They will upload 2k anonymized tickets; run 1-2 generation templates to evaluate precision/recall of action extraction (week 1).
3) If accuracy > 85% on key fields, expand to 50k tickets and add Zendesk webhook integration (week 2).

Quotes & call snippets:
- "We need something we can ship in 2–4 weeks — accuracy is more important than flash." — Head of Product
- "Cost is a big gating factor for us; if hosting costs spike we’ll look at self-hosted alternatives." — CTO

- Attach SOC2 summary + DPA link to reply thread.
- Book 30m POC kickoff (proposed 2026-03-15).

Open risks:

- Cost objections if Hosted API per-ticket economics aren't competitive vs. self-hosted quantized models.
- Need to validate structured-output reliability on noisy tickets (attachments, chat transcripts).
